id.description: get/delete by id instead of name.

inputs.description: run: the input values, e.g. {"topic": "…"}. upsert: the declared inputs, [{"name": "topic", "description": "…"}].

goal.description: run: what the run is for, as a person reads it in the task list (default: name and inputs).

context.description: run: extra context stored on the run Task.

scheduled_only.description: list: only workflows with a schedule (default false).

filter.description: list: case-insensitive substring of name or description.

verbose.description: list: add id, description, ownership, steps, checks. Keep false unless narrowed by `filter`.

reason.description: upsert/revert/delete: one line on why. Required when a save changes what the workflow does.

based_on.description: upsert/revert: the `version` get returned. Required when a save changes an existing workflow; refused if it has moved since.

version.description: history: the revision to read in full. revert: the revision to put back.

every.description: upsert: schedule period (30m, 6h, 1d, 1w); null removes the schedule.

checks.description: upsert: opt-in checks around a run.

default.description: upsert: make this the workflow free-text tasks run.

paused_reason.description: upsert: why it is disabled, when that is deliberate.

topic.description: upsert: the topics/*.yaml topic, or ""/null for one that spans topics.

data_class.description: upsert: stamped onto steps that set none.

paid.description: upsert: the owner approves (true) or withdraws (false) paid models for every step. Only the owner may grant it; a model-driven save that adds it is refused.

next_run_at.description: upsert: RFC3339 instant of the next scheduled run.

disable_broken.description: audit: disable workflows whose every step names a dead tool, and re-enable those an audit paused whose tools are live again.
